cards.back:
To make someone agree or do something by giving reasons.
Bahasa Indonesia: membujuk
Example: She tried to persuade her parents to adopt a puppy.
cards.say: persuade. To make someone agree or do something by giving reasons. She tried to persuade her parents to adopt a puppy.

cards.back:
To make someone believe that something is true.
Bahasa Indonesia: meyakinkan
Example: The clear facts convinced the teacher that the date should change.
cards.say: convince. To make someone believe that something is true. The clear facts convinced the teacher that the date should change.

cards.back:
To ask strongly or sincerely for something.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengimbau, memohon dengan sungguh-sungguh
Example: The charity made an appeal for warm blankets.
cards.say: appeal. To ask strongly or sincerely for something. The charity made an appeal for warm blankets.

cards.back:
Needing quick action.
Bahasa Indonesia: mendesak
Example: It is urgent that we clean the river before the monsoon.
cards.say: urgent. Needing quick action. It is urgent that we clean the river before the monsoon.

cards.back:
Absolutely needed.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat penting
Example: Clean water is essential for every person on Earth.
cards.say: essential. Absolutely needed. Clean water is essential for every person on Earth.

cards.back:
Extremely important.
Bahasa Indonesia: vital
Example: It is vital to wear a helmet when you ride a bicycle.
cards.say: vital. Extremely important. It is vital to wear a helmet when you ride a bicycle.

cards.back:
To make a picture in your mind. Writers use it to invite the reader to think.
Bahasa Indonesia: membayangkan
Example: Imagine a school where every child has a book to read.
cards.say: imagine. To make a picture in your mind. Writers use it to invite the reader to think. Imagine a school where every child has a book to read.

cards.back:
A question asked for effect that does not need an answer.
Bahasa Indonesia: pertanyaan retoris
Example: Who would not want cleaner air? That is a rhetorical question.
cards.say: rhetorical question. A question asked for effect that does not need an answer. Who would not want cleaner air? That is a rhetorical question.

cards.back:
A short, catchy phrase used to advertise something.
Bahasa Indonesia: slogan
Example: The slogan Save water, save life was printed on every poster.
cards.say: slogan. A short, catchy phrase used to advertise something. The slogan Save water, save life was printed on every poster.

cards.back:
To make something seem bigger or better than it is.
Bahasa Indonesia: melebih-lebihkan
Example: The advert exaggerated how fast the shoes could make you run.
cards.say: exaggerate. To make something seem bigger or better than it is. The advert exaggerated how fast the shoes could make you run.

cards.back:
Causing strong feelings.
Bahasa Indonesia: emosional, menggugah perasaan
Example: The emotive photograph of the injured owl made readers want to help.
cards.say: emotive. Causing strong feelings. The emotive photograph of the injured owl made readers want to help.

cards.back:
A number used to show a fact.
Bahasa Indonesia: statistik
Example: The leaflet used a statistic to show how many trees are lost.
cards.say: statistic. A number used to show a fact. The leaflet used a statistic to show how many trees are lost.

cards.back:
A statement from a person who praises a product.
Bahasa Indonesia: testimoni
Example: The shop displayed a testimonial from a happy customer.
cards.say: testimonial. A statement from a person who praises a product. The shop displayed a testimonial from a happy customer.

cards.back:
Words that tell the reader exactly what to do next.
Bahasa Indonesia: ajakan bertindak
Example: The poster ended with a call to action: join us on Saturday.
cards.say: call to action. Words that tell the reader exactly what to do next. The poster ended with a call to action: join us on Saturday.

cards.back:
Saying the same word or idea more than once for effect.
Bahasa Indonesia: pengulangan
Example: The speaker used repetition: we can, we will, we must.
cards.say: repetition. Saying the same word or idea more than once for effect. The speaker used repetition: we can, we will, we must.

cards.back:
Using three words or ideas together to sound powerful.
Bahasa Indonesia: pola tiga serangkai
Example: Fast, safe and cheap is an example of the rule of three.
cards.say: rule of three. Using three words or ideas together to sound powerful. Fast, safe and cheap is an example of the rule of three.

cards.back:
Praising someone too much to win their favour.
Bahasa Indonesia: sanjungan berlebihan, pujian palsu
Example: Flattery will not help you if your work is careless.
cards.say: flattery. Praising someone too much to win their favour. Flattery will not help you if your work is careless.

cards.back:
A promise that something will be as good as stated.
Bahasa Indonesia: jaminan
Example: The shop gave a guarantee that the watch would last two years.
cards.say: guarantee. A promise that something will be as good as stated. The shop gave a guarantee that the watch would last two years.

cards.back:
A planned set of actions to achieve an aim.
Bahasa Indonesia: kampanye
Example: Our class started a campaign to stop litter in the playground.
cards.say: campaign. A planned set of actions to achieve an aim. Our class started a campaign to stop litter in the playground.

cards.back:
A written request signed by many people.
Bahasa Indonesia: petisi
Example: We collected a hundred names on a petition for a safer crossing.
cards.say: petition. A written request signed by many people. We collected a hundred names on a petition for a safer crossing.

cards.back:
An advantage or good result.
Bahasa Indonesia: manfaat
Example: One benefit of reading every day is a bigger vocabulary.
cards.say: benefit. An advantage or good result. One benefit of reading every day is a bigger vocabulary.

cards.back:
A set of reasons given to support an opinion.
Bahasa Indonesia: argumen
Example: Her argument for a longer break was clear and sensible.
cards.say: argument. A set of reasons given to support an opinion. Her argument for a longer break was clear and sensible.

cards.back:
A reason that goes against another opinion.
Bahasa Indonesia: argumen tandingan
Example: He listed a counter-argument to explain why the plan might fail.
cards.say: counter-argument. A reason that goes against another opinion. He listed a counter-argument to explain why the plan might fail.
